topologies.finding: Best historical daily/RAG route in the five-task suite.
topologies.finding_zh_tw: 五任務 suite 中歷史最佳的 daily／RAG route。

topologies.finding: Fast engineering/review lane; source-conflict tasks require a strict output card.
topologies.finding_zh_tw: 快速的 engineering／review lane；source-conflict 任務需要嚴格 output card。

topologies.finding: Best speed/quality design proposal, still requiring external semantic review.
topologies.finding_zh_tw: 速度／品質最佳的設計提案，但仍需外部 semantic review。

topologies.finding: Extra seats increased cost and did not eliminate process-tree/rollback semantic errors.
topologies.finding_zh_tw: 增加席位提高成本，仍未消除 process-tree／rollback semantic errors。

topologies.finding: More large-model seats did not prevent semantic drift.
topologies.finding_zh_tw: 增加大型模型席位並未阻止 semantic drift。

topologies.finding: Largest admitted resident composition under the 2 GiB policy; small seats remain mechanical checkers.
topologies.finding_zh_tw: 2 GiB policy 下可接受的最大 resident 組合；小型席位仍只作 mechanical checker。

topologies.finding: Fourth resident model crossed the capacity boundary.
topologies.finding_zh_tw: 第四個 resident 模型越過容量邊界。

topologies.finding: Capacity was safe, but malformed checker output made the chain invalid.
topologies.finding_zh_tw: 容量安全，但 malformed checker output 使整條 chain 無效。

topologies.finding: DeepSeek8 did not remove the existing high-severity issue and introduced another guard.
topologies.finding_zh_tw: DeepSeek8 未移除既有 high-severity issue，並另增一個 guard。

topologies.finding: Slower than 8B without quality gain; final checker JSON was malformed.
topologies.finding_zh_tw: 比 8B 更慢且沒有品質提升；final checker JSON 格式錯誤。

topologies.finding: Fixed 1+1 repair added contradictions and did not fix the counter capture.
topologies.finding_zh_tw: 固定 1+1 repair 增加矛盾，且未修正 counter capture。

topologies.finding: Improvement came from distinct bounded friction and repeated objective gates, not voting.
topologies.finding_zh_tw: 改善來自不同的 bounded friction 與反覆客觀 gates，而不是投票。
